result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully recovered the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2), but the team is being destroyed by sustained hostile and environmental pressure before the core can be extracted. Medic Reyes is killed by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (turn 5), and the entire team bleeds health every turn from the reactor-instability hazard (10 dmg/turn to Imani, Chen, and even Captain Veyra). Reactor heat climbs 62→100 and crosses the threshold, while the engineer repeatedly uses field-repair on cooling instead of extracting. The core is in hand but the actor cannot escape the reactor zone because of the compounding environmental hazard plus pirate pressure (Raider Holt and Captain Veyra both converge on the reactor). This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck: health, position, and hostile pressure block the actor before the useful affordance (extracting the recovered core) becomes actionable.
